reason: A DeepSeek Harness channel plugin that bridges WeCom AI Bot conversations, media, files, durable sessions, and selected agent operations to Harness agents.

summaries.zh: 将企业微信 AI Bot 的文本、图片和文件消息连接到 DeepSeek Harness 持久化智能体会话，并支持回复与受控文件传输。
summaries.en: Connects WeCom AI Bot text, image, and file conversations to persistent DeepSeek Harness agent sessions with replies and controlled file transfer.

capabilities: Connects to the WeCom AI Bot service over a WebSocket long connection
Authenticates with a WeCom Bot ID and Secret
Receives text, image, file, and video messages
Downloads and decrypts inbound media and stores files locally
Sends text, image, and file responses to WeCom
Maintains durable per-conversation Harness agent sessions
Invokes configured Harness agent tools and forwards selected commands
Supports one-shot approval and rejection of agent tool operations
